member.name: T:HuggingFaceClient.DTO.ChatCompletion.ChatCompletionRequestDto
member.summary:
Represents a request payload used to generate a chat-based completion from a language model.
This DTO includes: - Model: The identifier of the language model to use. - Messages: A list of message objects forming the chat history and context. - Temperature: A value (0–1) controlling randomness in the output; higher means more randomness. - TopP: Controls the nucleus sampling; limits choices to the most probable tokens with cumulative probability top_p. - MaxNewTokens: Specifies the maximum number of tokens to generate in the response. - RepetitionPenalty: Penalizes repeated phrases or tokens to improve diversity. - Stream: If true, the output is returned as a stream of tokens.
These properties allow fine-grained control over how the model generates and returns chat responses.

member.name: T:HuggingFaceClient.DTO.ChatCompletion.MessageDto
member.summary:
Represents a single message exchanged within a chat conversation, typically used as part of a chat history in a chat completion request.
Each message contains: - Role: The source of the message (e.g., "user", "assistant", or "system"). - Content: The textual content of the message.
This DTO is used to construct the conversational context that the model uses to generate appropriate and coherent responses.
